text: Testing plays a key role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, while integration tests make sure different parts work together. Many developers use test-driven development, or TDD, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them find problems early and improve the design. Although writing tests takes time, it gives teams more confidence. When tests pass, developers feel safe making changes because they know they haven't broken anything. In short, good testing leads to better software and fewer surprises.
